name: Bûche
source:
Noel twin and shares hobby of dressing up like a maid. Being from class 2-A keeps up tradition of not liking or getting along with students of class 2-C. They say easiest way to tell apart besides Buche being superior athlete is to wait for them to talk. Buche will often be rude to people she see's as inferior. 

Likes: [url=/c42551]Ojousama[/url]
Dislikes: Studying
Hobbies: Taking care of [url=/c39110]Noël[/url]
